statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is directly mapped from the single line item 'Depreciation and amortization' in the operating activities section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. The supplementary tables provide additional detail on operating lease components (e.g., right-of-use asset amortization, rental expense) which are part of the total depreciation and amortization expense, but the primary statement already reports the consolidated total. Therefore, only the primary statement line item is used.
